messages.en:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 14 00}I'm not so good at
remembering names, so I
use colors instead.
See, I just think up a color
that describes what kind of
personality you have.
{09 03 00}Then, I just remember you
as, like, Green {04 00 00}!
Or Purple {04 01 00}!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 14 00}Ma ei oska eriti hästi
nimesid meelde jätta, nii
et kasutan hoopis värve.
Vaata, ma mõtlen välja
värvi, mis kirjeldab su
isiksust.
{09 03 00}Siis ma lihtsalt mäletan
sind kui Roheline {04 00 00}!
Või Lilla {04 01 00}!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 14 00}That sounds pretty cool.
I'm jealous. {01 00 00 0a 00}Things were
different when I was little.
My dad would leap out of
the closet wearing a hockey
mask when I went to bed.
{07 07 00}That's why I always chuck a
brick into my closet before
I go to sleep, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 14 00}See kõlab päris lahedalt.
Ma olen kade. {01 00 00 0a 00}Minu lapse-
põlves oli asi teisiti.
Mu isa hüppas kapist välja
hokimask peas, kui ma
magama läksin.
{07 07 00}Sellepärast viskan ma alati
enne magamist kapi tellise,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 08 00}Aaaaaah! Stop it! Can't we
just have a normal
conversation for once?
{07 16 00}Why do you have to keep
playing pranks on me like
that, {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}?{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 08 00}Aaaaaah! Lõpeta! Kas me ei
või kordki pidada
tavalist vestlust?
{07 16 00}Miks sa pead mind kogu aeg
niimoodi vingerpussitama,
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}?{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 1b 00}My dad taught me all the
best practical jokes! He's
the best{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}So maybe we've got
something in common after
all, huh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{09 01 00}{07 14 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 1b 00}Mu isa õpetas mulle kõik
parimad vingerpussid! Ta on
parim{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}Nii et ehk on meil ikkagi
midagi ühist,
mis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{09 01 00}{07 14 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 00 00}Let me explain it for you.
See, I am a master of the
arts of fighting.
{07 14 00}In my mind, I have already
fought this battle a
million times!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 00 00}Las ma seletan sulle.
Vaata, ma olen võitlus-
kunstide meister.
{07 14 00}Oma peas olen ma seda
lahingut juba miljon
korda pidanud!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 09 00}That's it?{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00} You played this
out a million times, and
that's your best comeback?
Look, it's an easy question.
Do you want to come over
for cupcakes or not?{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 09 00}Kas see ongi?{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00} Sa mängisid
seda miljon korda läbi ja
see on su parim vastus?
Vaata, küsimus on lihtne.
Kas sa tahad koogikeste
peale tulla või mitte?{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 15 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}wait a sec!{01 00 00 0a 00} Are you
gonna tell me it's black?{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 05 00}Come on, that's so obvious!
{07 14 00}I used to think the same
thing until I went to see
this color coordinator.
{07 19 00}He told me I'm an autumn.
He says my power color is
burnt umber. I gotta say.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 15 00}I, for one, think he's on to
something! {01 00 00 05 00}But {07 0b 00}what were
you going to say?{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 15 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}oota veidi!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kas sa
kavatsed öelda, et must?{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 05 00}Ole nüüd, see on ilmne!
{07 14 00}Ma arvasin ka nii, kuni
ma käisin ühe värvi-
konsultandi juures.
{07 19 00}Ta ütles, et ma olen sügis.
Ta ütleb, et mu jõuvärv on
põletatud umbra. Pean.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 15 00}Minu arust on tal midagi
õiget! {01 00 00 05 00}Aga {07 0b 00}mida sa
öelda tahtsid?{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 0e 00}Black? That's such a sad
color for you, {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}!
No, I think of you as a{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0c 00}Wait, no! You really are a
burnt umber! {01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}I can't believe
I never saw it before!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 0e 00}Must? See on sulle nii
kurb värv, {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}!
Ei, ma pean sind pigem{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0c 00}Oota, ei! Sa oledki
põletatud umbra! {01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}Uskumatu,
et ma seda enne ei näinud!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 00 00}Yeah, I mean, I was going
to say black at first, but
he's totally got you pegged.
{07 14 00}What you need is a little
color to bring out your
inner warmth.{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 00 00}Jah, ma mõtlen, ma tahtsin
kõigepealt öelda must, aga
ta tabas sind täiesti ära.
{07 14 00}Sa vajad natuke värvi, mis
tooks välja su sisemise
soojuse.{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}I've got inner warmth?
No one's ever told me that
before! Thanks!
I have ZERO idea what you're
talking about, but it sounds
cool, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}Mul on sisemine soojus?
Keegi pole mulle seda varem
öelnud! Aitäh!
Mul pole AIMUGI, millest sa
räägid, aga see kõlab
lahedalt, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
